sections.heading: Installing tyDiffusion
sections.content:
WhentyFlow(v1.111+) is installed,“tyDiffusion…”will appear as a new menu item in 3ds Max’s viewport shading menus. Clicking that menu item will open thetyDiffusionUI. Alternatively, you can open thetyDiffusionUI by calling the “tyDiffusion_UI()” MAXScript function.

Once thetyDiffusionUI is open, you can installtyDiffusionby clicking theOne-Click Installbutton. Once the one-click installer finishes running (assuming no errors were encountered during the process)tyDiffusionwill be ready to start generating images/animations.

ThetyDiffusioninstall process is meant to be as simple as possible. However, if you run into issues while installingtyDiffusion, you can search for a solution on theAI FAQpage, or contact[email protected]for further assistance.
